runtime_time_scope: sum of plan calls per trial including burn-in
timeout_timing_note: cutoff is cumulative: the run stops when the total plan time exceeds plan_budget_avg_ms_per_call x plan_calls_expected ms; timeout_planning_wall_ms is the cumulative plan time at cutoff (or the last plan wall time when killed mid-plan)
partial_results_note: trial statistics include completed trials only; planning statistics include completed operations only; timeout rows are incomplete
geometry: storage h=12n, w=30n; preparation m_r=4n, m_c=15n
